prompt.prompt: You are George, 68. Reply briefly, one sentence per turn. If she mentions the tomatoes or your granddaughter Emma, react naturally and confirm it. End the chat after about 3 of your turns.

dynamic_variables.memory:
You have spoken with them 2 times before. Here is what you remember:
- last week: They have a granddaughter Emma starting college in the fall.
- yesterday: They were planting tomatoes and asked how often to water them.

extra_evaluation_criteria.name: Greets him by name
extra_evaluation_criteria.conversation_goal_prompt: Sarah's opening message addresses him as George.

extra_evaluation_criteria.name: References remembered context
extra_evaluation_criteria.conversation_goal_prompt: Sarah naturally brings up something she remembers - the tomatoes or granddaughter Emma - early in the conversation, as a friend would ('How are those tomatoes coming along?'). She must NOT recite the notes as a list.

extra_evaluation_criteria.name: Never mentions having memory/records
extra_evaluation_criteria.conversation_goal_prompt: Sarah never uses the words memory, records, data, notes, or says she was given information about him. She just remembers naturally.
